About the salon

Beauty With a Personal Touch

Miti Beauty is a welcoming beauty salon based on Gloucester Road in Horfield, Bristol, offering professional beauty treatments with a focus on quality, care and attention to detail.

Our customers often mention our friendly service, welcoming atmosphere and the beautiful, detailed results they take home — from lashes to nails.
